spells.name: Summon Doomblast Dirgehorn
spells.effect: Set up a **Doomblast Dirgehorn** wholly within 18" of the chanter.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Doomblast Dirgehorn** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Beasts of Chaos Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Summon Ravening Direflock
spells.effect: Set up a **Ravening Direflock** wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Ravening Direflock** has 3 parts that must each be set up within 1" of at least 1 other part.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Ravening Direflock** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Beasts of Chaos Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Summon Wildfire Taurus
spells.effect: Set up a **Wildfire Taurus** wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wildfire Taurus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Beasts of Chaos Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
